title: Explicit etale residue transport and preservation of cohomological bounds
statement: For schemes X and S [def-pc-scheme], a morphism i:S→X [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], a commutative ring A and ideal I, form the fixed etale residue complex C over A/I [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. Define C′ by exact etale inverse image, precomposition along AsSmall.down [def-weil-size-convention], the inverse of normalized constant-scalar restriction, and standard derived localization [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. If H^q(C)=0 outside [a,b], then H^q(C′)=0 outside [a,b]. This construction makes no perfection or finiteness assumption.

proof.text: Use precomposition by AsSmall.down and its strict inverse to construct the site equivalence. Compose with the inverse equivalence of normalized scalar restriction to define the residue functor and localize its termwise image of C.
Inverse image and the coefficient equivalence are exact. Compose the standard localization homology comparison and the exact-functor homology comparison. The original zero homology maps to zero.
